title: Rating the goodbye at the door: three tries, one wave too many
old_caption: Rating the goodbye at the door: one goodbye in the dark after the light timed out, two wrong-way exits, and one tiny wave from the top of a hill. Score: adorable. Then a knock.

title: Rating the playlist they made me
old_caption: Aquarius rates the playlist they were made: a song about its laugh, forty seconds of rain (it likes rain), and track three, which is just them saying hi. Rewound it. Rewound it again.

title: Libra thinks about one compliment on their shoes, daily
old_caption: Someone said 'nice shoes' once, in passing. Libra built a marble statue about it and thinks about it at 3 AM. What tiny compliment lives in your head rent free?

title: Scorpio thinks about eye contact across the room
old_caption: Scorpio's Roman Empire: one look across the room. Practiced in the mirror at 7 AM, still seeing it at 3 AM. Then Capricorn admits it's their Roman Empire too. Have you ever had a look like that?

title: Cancer thinks about text me when you get home
old_caption: One date said 'text me when you get home', and Cancer has reported in ever since: home from work, home from the store, home from getting a glass of water. Someone worried! What tiny moment lives in your head?

title: Taurus thinks about the sandwich their date shared on date one
old_caption: Taurus thinks about it at breakfast, at lunch and at 3 AM: a date once said 'want half?' and cut the sandwich diagonally. Who does that? What's your Roman Empire?

title: Virgo thinks about the typo in their first message
old_caption: Virgo's first message said 'relly nice', and they think about it every single day: proofreading the grocery list, typing 'really' slowly, drafting an apology at 3 AM. The typo is why Gemini replied.

title: The signs ordering at a dinner date
old_caption: Aries ordered before sitting down, Taurus started with dessert, Libra kept the waiter waiting, and Pisces cried at the free bread. Which one are you at dinner?

title: The signs at a movie date
old_caption: Aries guessed the ending during the trailer, Gemini whispered the whole time, Scorpio watched your face during the twist, and Sag woke up for the credits. Which sign are you at the movies?

title: The signs as roommates
old_caption: Aries built the shelf with three spare screws, Gemini made a group chat for the fridge, Libra moves the couch every Sunday. Which roommate are you, be honest?
